mutants.name: r9_03_student_t_chi_square_reused_every_second_draw.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-9 student-error mutant. Student-t chi-square drawn on even draws, reused on the next.

mutants.name: r9_04_gaussian_stream_skips_first_normal.py
mutants.description: Round-9 verifier (slice d) student-error mutant: the Gaussian family draws one standard normal and discards it before the first draw, so the frozen Gaussian stream of Conventions item 5 is shifted by one normal.

mutants.name: r9_05_loss_floored_not_rounded.py
mutants.description: Round-9 verifier (slice d) student-error mutant: each portfolio loss is floored to a whole cent instead of rounded once to the nearest cent.

mutants.name: r9_06_matched_factor_squared_in_t_scale.py
mutants.description: Round-9 verifier (slice d) student-error mutant: the Student-t scale applies the matched factor twice, sqrt(s^2 nu / W) instead of sqrt(s nu / W), so the returns are shrunk by a factor of s.

mutants.name: r9_07_last_pivot_unchecked_for_three_positions.py
mutants.description: Round-9 verifier (slice d) student-error mutant: for a three-position covariance the positive-pivot check is skipped on the last row, so a non-positive last pivot is accepted instead of raising ValueError.

mutants.name: v1_01_losses_floored_at_zero.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-1 student-error mutant. Gains are floored at zero, so a portfolio that rises records a zero loss.

mutants.name: v1_02_student_t_ignores_seed.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-1 student-error mutant. The Student-t family ignores the seed and draws from an unseeded generator.

mutants.name: v1_03_quantile_index_round_half_even.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-1 student-error mutant. The 99% index is round(0.99 n), not the ceiling, so n = 99 picks the 98th loss.

mutants.name: v1_04_loss_rounded_half_up_by_truncation.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-1 student-error mutant. Losses are rounded by int(x + 0.5), which truncates toward zero, not to the nearest cent.

mutants.name: v1_05_positions_read_in_dollars.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-1 student-error mutant. Positions are read as dollars (cents divided by 100) inside the loss.

mutants.name: v1_06_matched_factor_inverted.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-1 student-error mutant. The Student-t scale uses the reciprocal of the matched factor, nu / (nu - 2), instead of (nu - 2) / nu.

mutants.name: v2_01_short_position_read_as_long.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-2 student-error mutant. A short position is read as a long one: the loss uses the absolute value of each position.

mutants.name: v2_02_upper_factor_used_as_lower.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-2 student-error mutant. The upper-triangular factor is used where the lower one belongs, so each return is L^T Z, not L Z.

mutants.name: v2_03_zero_pivot_accepted.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-2 student-error mutant. The pivot test is written not-negative, so a zero variance is accepted as positive definite.

mutants.name: v2_04_normals_drawn_in_reverse_position_order.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-2 student-error mutant. The m standard normals of each draw are taken in reverse position order, not in position order.

mutants.name: v3_m02_round_half_up_by_truncation.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant. Losses are rounded with int(x + 0.5) instead of round(), which rounds a negative loss toward zero half a cent too high.

mutants.name: v3_m03_loss_scaled_by_weights.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant. Each position is divided by the total portfolio value before the loss is formed, so the loss is a fraction of a cent-valued weight, not cents.

mutants.name: v4_m01_loss_rounded_per_position.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-4 student-error mutant. Each position's loss is rounded to a whole cent before the positions are summed, so the loss is not rounded once as the page states.

mutants.name: v4_m02_matched_factor_skipped_for_small_nu.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-4 student-error mutant. The matched factor is applied only when nu > 4, so the Student-t draws at nu = 3 and nu = 4 are inflated by nu / (nu - 2).

mutants.name: v4_m03_loss_sign_folded.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-4 student-error mutant. The loss is taken as the absolute value of the portfolio return, so a gain is recorded as a positive loss.

mutants.name: v5_m01_matched_scale_applied_not_square_rooted.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-5 student-error mutant. (nu - 2) / nu multiplies the return, not its square root.

mutants.name: v5_m02_positions_applied_in_reverse_order.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-5 student-error mutant. Each return is weighted by the mirrored asset's position.

mutants.name: v5_m03_quantile_index_rounded_not_ceiled.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-5 student-error mutant. The 99% index is round(0.99 n), not its ceiling.

mutants.name: v6_01_student_t_chi_square_has_two_nu_degrees_of_freedom.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v6). Student-t chi-square drawn with shape nu (2 nu degrees of freedom) instead of nu / 2 (nu degrees of freedom).

mutants.name: v6_02_one_chi_square_variable_for_the_whole_run.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v6). Student-t uses one chi-square variable for the whole run, drawn once before the first draw, not one per draw.

mutants.name: v6_03_third_position_dropped_from_the_loss.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v6). The loss sums the first two positions only, so a three-position portfolio ignores its third position.

mutants.name: v6_04_quantile_takes_the_order_statistic_of_absolute_losses.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v6). The 99% loss is the order statistic of the absolute losses, so a gain can set the quantile.

mutants.name: v6_05_matched_ratio_inverted_in_the_chi_square_scale.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v6). The chi-square scale is sqrt(matched * W / nu), the inverse of sqrt(matched * nu / W), so the returns shrink.

mutants.name: v7_01_chi_square_drawn_per_position.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v7). Student-t draws one chi-square variable per position, not one per draw, so the assets of a draw get different scales.

mutants.name: v7_02_quantile_index_floor_plus_one.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v7). The 99% index is floor(0.99 n) + 1, one order statistic high whenever 0.99 n is a whole number (n = 100, 200).

mutants.name: v7_03_loss_rounded_per_position.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v7). Each position's cent amount is rounded before the sum, so the portfolio loss is rounded per position, not once.

mutants.name: v7_04_chi_square_scale_one.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v7). The chi-square draw uses scale 1 instead of 2, so W has half its stated mean nu and the Student-t factor is wrong.

mutants.name: v8_01_matched_scale_multiplies_chi_by_nu_over_nu_inverted.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-4 student-error mutant (v8). The Student-t scale inverts the chi-square ratio: sqrt(s * W / nu) instead of sqrt(s * nu / W), so the variance is not nu/(nu-2).

mutants.name: v8_02_quantile_zero_based_floor_index.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-4 student-error mutant (v8). quantile_99 reads the 0-based floor index (99 n) // 100 instead of the 1-based ceiling index, so it returns the next order statistic up.

mutants.name: v8_03_student_t_uses_transposed_factor.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-4 student-error mutant (v8). The return uses L transposed times Z (the upper-triangular factor) instead of L Z, so the return covariance is L^T L, not Sigma.

mutants.name: v9_01_chi_square_shared_by_even_draws.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-5 (v9): even-indexed Student-t draws share one chi-square variable.

mutants.name: v9_02_normal_vector_drawn_once_per_run.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-5 (v9): the normal vector Z is drawn once per run and reused for every draw.

mutants.name: v9_03_gaussian_stream_draws_unused_chi_square.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-5 (v9): the Gaussian family draws an unused chi-square variable.

mutants.name: v9_04_student_t_scale_drops_chi_square_ratio.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-5 (v9): the Student-t family drops the chi-square ratio from its scale.
